name: Trow
description: Faerie beings who live below the earth and cannot return home if caught above ground at sunrise; they may cast spontaneous Terram spells.

name: Kunal Trow
description: The 'king' trow, a more powerful trow that takes villages under its care in exchange for a bride or groom and may learn all gruagach powers.

name: Merrows
description: Fish-people of the Western Islands whose treasure the sea churns onto the beaches; they capsize boats that try to leave with it.

name: Garron
description: The small, surefooted Highland pony used to haul loads rather than for riding or war.

name: Cu (Greyhound)
description: The Scottish deerhound or greyhound, a slender sight-hunting dog kept by most Highland households to hunt and protect herds.

name: Brownie
description: Helpful household faeries of Scotland; brownies perform household chores at Crun Clach.

name: Bocan
description: A helpful type of Scottish faerie mentioned alongside brownies.

name: Brollachan
description: A formless, boneless, fleshy dark faerie that lurks in crevices or abandoned houses and smothers and eats victims with pseudopods.

name: Each Uisge
description: The water horse, a dark faerie of beach and sea-loch that shifts between black horse and handsome man, with sticky skin that traps victims to be devoured.

name: Seelie Court
description: The nobility of the faerie race, who live in knowes, love mortal music and poetry, ride in rades, and sometimes kidnap mortal musicians.

name: Unseelie Court
description: The dark faeries, mostly solitary in Scotland, who lurk in streams, pools and ruins and often kill mortals.

name: Workplace Faeries
description: Household or workplace faeries, solitary creatures who help with chores for a traditional due and leave if spied on or overpaid.

name: The Good Folk
description: Euphemistic name for the fey used by the Scots, along with the people of peace, the gentry and the wee folk.

name: Duine Sith
description: 'People of peace', communities of fey living near stone monuments who oversee their use and prevent their destruction.

name: Sluagh
description: Collective host of hundreds or thousands of undead spirits haunting the Highlands that can drive humans insane or frighten them to death.

name: Cu Sith
description: Green faerie dogs whose bark presages death if heard three times; wild in the Highlands and kept by the good folk in the South.

name: Babhan Sith
description: An unseelie solitary fairy woman who lures men into a glamoured dance in a moorland shieling and drinks their blood.

name: Redcap (faerie)
description: A solitary dark faerie living in cliffs and abandoned towers that drops stones on passersby and dips its hat in their blood.

name: Grochan
description: Minor faeries who, along with brownies, perform household chores at Crun Clach.

name: Scottish Wildcat
description: An untameable, solitary Scottish cat said to foretell weather and call wind and rain; favored by shapeshifters.

name: Wild Boar
description: Dangerous forest boar of Scotland that fights on even when mortally wounded.

name: Bark of Doom
description: Power of the cu sith: if the dog barks three times at a person, death soon follows.

name: Sticky Skin
description: Each uisge power (ReCo 25) making its skin adhere to anyone who touches it.

name: Attract the Doomed Victim
description: Each uisge power (MuMe 30) lessening a victim's caution so they climb onto its back.

name: Shapechange to Man
description: Each uisge power (MuCo 45) to take the form of a handsome dark-haired man.

name: Mind Suggestion
description: Sluagh power (ReMe 30) implanting suggestions to kill or destroy what the target holds dear.

name: Frighten
description: Sluagh power (PeMe 30) that drives a target insane with terror.

name: Vampirism
description: Babhan sith power to suck the blood of her dancing partners, draining body levels.

name: Infatuation
description: Babhan sith power creating strong amorous attraction in males by sight and sound.

name: Vulnerability to Iron
description: Faerie weakness whereby blows of cold iron cause extra damage to the babhan sith.

name: Glamour
description: Faerie illusion magic used to disguise places, creatures and money; cold iron destroys it.

name: Pseudopods
description: Brollachan power to extend fleshy tentacles to strike, grapple and smother foes.

name: Fascination
description: Caitlin's faerie power making people desire her praise and follow reasonable requests, equivalent to ReMe 25.

name: Faerie Eyes
description: Faerie ability that allows seeing through glamour, e.g. to find the door of Crun Clach.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Caitlin's faerie power to converse with all animals except reptiles and dark faerie creatures.

name: Very Tough
description: Faerie power granting +7 to Soak.

name: Invisibility
description: Ability/power of cu sith and Gliocas to vanish when followed.

name: Faerie Powers
description: Special abilities possessed by faeries such as Claws, Glamour, Infatuation and Vampirism.

name: Western Islands
description: The islands west of Scotland, called the Sudreys by the Norse, divided into the Outer and Inner Hebrides.

name: Outer Hebrides
description: The western group of the Western Islands, battered by Atlantic storms.

name: Inner Hebrides
description: Island group close to the Scottish mainland with deeply cut sealochs and slightly better weather.

name: Isle of Man
description: Island in the Irish Sea, rich in vis and faeries, with two gateways to Arcadia; neutral under the Partitio Monaviae.

name: Douglas
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Ramsey
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Peel
description: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

name: Kintyre
description: Peninsula added to the kingdom of Man by Magnus Barelegs in 1098; rich in stone alignments.

name: Islay
description: Southern island group granted to Somerled in 1156.

name: Mull
description: Southern island group granted to Somerled in 1156.

name: Skye
description: Hebridean island where the king of Man's hold was weakened; site of the Callanish stones per the text.

name: Dublin
description: City seized by Godred Crovan along with the Sudreys.

name: Iona
description: Holy island where St. Columba founded his first church; has a Dominion aura of 8 of the Scottish temper.

name: Arn cul-ri Eirin
description: Cairn on Iona marking where Columba found he could no longer see Ireland.

name: Relig Oran
description: Burial place of kings on Iona, where most Scottish kings and St. Oran lie.

name: Stonehenge
description: The great stone circle in England, best known monument of the British Isles.

name: Argyle
description: Western Scottish region with numerous stone alignments and pig-keeping, part of old Dalriada.

name: Lewis
description: Hebridean island with large stone circles.

name: Orkneys
description: Northern islands held by Norse descendants, whose Mainland has large stone circles.

name: Mainland (Orkney)
description: Principal island of the Orkneys, site of the Stennes stones.

name: Buchan
description: Northern Lowland region with many recumbent stone circles.

name: Mar
description: Northern Lowland region with many recumbent stone circles.

name: Inverness
description: Area with standing stone circles.

name: Callanish Stones
description: Great stone circle said to lead to Barathrum, Antrum and Tartarus; a gateway to Arcadia with aura 10.

name: Stennes Stones
description: Stone circle on Mainland in the Orkneys leading to Barathrum and Caelum; a gateway to Arcadia.

name: Camac
description: Stone monument site in Brittany to which the stones may allow travel.

name: Shetland Islands
description: Northern islands held by Viking descendants who speak Norse.

name: Caithness
description: Northern region partly held by Norse-speaking descendants of Vikings.

name: Ross
description: Remote region where isolated clans speak Gaelic with Pictish elements.

name: Sutherland
description: Remote region where isolated clans speak Gaelic with Pictish elements.

name: Dalriada
description: The old kingdom in the West of Scotland where some people keep pigs.

name: Pictland
description: Land of the Picts, conquered by Kenneth MacAlpin.

name: Highlands
description: Northern mountainous Scotland, Gaelic-speaking and clan-organized, home to many faeries.

name: Lowlands
description: Southern Scotland, where Scottish is spoken and cattle are driven to market.

name: Borders
description: Region between Scotland and England, home to many seelie courts and raiding families.

name: Hadrian's Wall
description: Roman wall marking the English border; Horsingas lies eight miles north of it.

name: Cheviot Hills
description: Hills along the Tyne where the covenant of Horsingas is located.

name: Tyne River
description: River along which Horsingas lies.

name: Bamburgh
description: Town forty miles northwest of Horsingas.

name: Carlisle
description: Town thirty miles southwest of Horsingas where the magi are wanted.

name: Hexham Priory
description: Priory headed by Abbot Geoffrey, frequently raided by Horsingas for supplies.

name: Shropshire
description: English county where Whitburh was left to starve as a child.

name: Surrey
description: English region of Sir Jehan's claimed origin.

name: Keswick
description: Place-name origin of Ealwynn of Keswick.

name: Northumbria
description: Northern English region harried by William the Conqueror.

name: Yorkshire
description: Northern English region harried by William the Conqueror.

name: Scotland
description: The land of the Loch Leglean Tribunal, divided by geography and language.

name: Ireland
description: Homeland of Columba and source of Gaelic; Seumas's master was executed there.

name: Poland
description: Radislav's homeland.

name: Hungary
description: Where Radislav studied under a Criamon magus.

name: Sithean
description: A faerie mound; Crun Clach lies inside one.

name: Knowe
description: Faerie hills where seelie faeries live; farmers avoid planting or grazing on them.

name: Shieling
description: Temporary stone, turf or wood huts at summer pastures; babhan sith dwell in abandoned ones.

name: Arcadia
description: The faerie otherworld; the Isle of Man and great stone circles contain gateways to it.

name: Barathrum
description: Faerie realm of the land of the dead, associated with stone circles and standing stones.

name: Antrum
description: Faerie realm of earth and rock, associated with recumbent circles.

name: Caelum
description: Faerie realm of air and stars, associated with stone alignments.

name: Tartarus
description: Otherworld realm the Callanish stones are rumored to lead to.

name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm of faerie power, one of the four realms; its auras surround stone monuments.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm; Iona has a Dominion aura of level 8.

name: Magic Realm
description: One of the four realms of power giving rise to regiones and magic auras.

name: Infernal
description: One of the four realms of power named in the regio definition.

name: Regio
description: An area where supernatural power allows access to multiple overlapping places; Crun Clach occupies a three-level regio.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural strength of a place (Faerie, Magic, Dominion) such as the aura 10 of great stone circles.

name: Aura of the Scottish Church
description: Scottish temper of Dominion aura, as found on Iona.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power found in creatures, monuments and places, measured in pawns, rooks and queens.

name: Pawn
description: Unit of vis equal to 1.

name: Rook
description: Unit of vis equal to 10.

name: Queen
description: Unit of vis equal to 100.

name: Twilight
description: Magical state magi may enter; Radislav has had bouts from faerie food and it might restore Jehan's memory.

name: Familiar
description: Animal magically bonded to a magus through cords, such as Raedbora, Volya and Triath nan Leathad.

name: Bond Cords
description: The Bronze, Silver and Gold cords linking magus and familiar; Radislav also forged an Enigmatic cord.

name: Enigmatic Cord
description: Special familiar cord forged by Radislav with Volya granting the Visions talent.

name: Bond Qualities
description: Familiar bond powers such as Independence, Shared Senses and Unlimited Bond.

name: Shared Senses
description: Bond quality letting magus and familiar use each other's senses.

name: Heartbeast
description: A Bjornaer magus's animal form, e.g. Ealwynn's stoat and Coenwulf's boar.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Magical potion that extends life; Aelfred's went wrong and aged him rapidly.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: Distinctive manifestation accompanying a magus's spells.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal declared hostilities between magi, as declared against Seumas's master.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The laws of the Order, which Horsingas breaks by interfering in mundane affairs.

name: Covenant Seasons
description: Life stages of covenants: Spring, Summer, Autumn.

name: Partitio Monaviae
description: 1145 document by a special tribunal declaring Man neutral until a covenant is founded there.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Magic drawing on faerie power, practiced by House Merinita; triggers Iain's pig curse.

name: Iain's Curse
description: Unseelie curse causing Iain Mac Gabhan to partially turn into a pig when casting faerie spells.

name: Enigma
description: The mystery studied by House Criamon; Radislav seeks it among the faeries.

name: Quarter Days
description: Scottish seasonal festival days marking the change of seasons, when vis and stones may be active.

name: Oidhche Challuin
description: New Year's Eve in the Highland calendar, with the tradition of first footing.

name: First Footing
description: Tradition that the first person to cross a house's threshold at New Year brings luck.

name: Imbolc
description: Quarter day on February 1, the Feast of St. Bride.

name: Beltane
description: May 1 quarter day of fire rites and herd migration; the glamour of Crun Clach is thin then.

name: Lughnasa
description: August 1 celebration once honoring Lugh, marking the start of harvest.

name: St. Mary's Day
description: August 15 feast by which the harvest is normally over.

name: Samhain
description: November 1 eve when the dead walk and the otherworld is accessible.

name: Oigh
description: The 'maiden', the first harvest sheaf cut by a chosen girl.

name: Cailleach
description: The 'old woman', the last harvest sheaf, subject of faerie-related customs.

name: Cas-chrom
description: The Highland footplow, a long-handled tool with an iron head used to turn soil.

name: Hard Tartan
description: Water-shedding woolen cloth made from oily Highland wool.

name: Merk
description: Scottish unit of value equal to 2/3 of a pound, with no coin.

name: Scots Penny
description: Silver coin introduced by David I, equal to the English penny.

name: Ogham
description: Monument writing used for Gaelic and Pictish inscriptions, no longer living.

name: Pictish
description: Dead magical language preserved only by gruagachan, aiding their Geasa and Curses.

name: Gaelic
description: Predominant language of the Highlands brought by the Scotti from Ireland.

name: Norse
description: Language of the Viking descendants in the Hebrides, Orkneys, Shetlands and Man.

name: Scottish (language)
description: Southern language mixing Anglian, Norman French and Gaelic.

name: Old Saxon
description: Dying language used as the covenant language of Horsingas.

name: Latin
description: Language of the clergy and predominant written language; Horsingas uses Latin code words.

name: Shinty
description: Faerie and Highland ball game related to hurly; Caitlin won Crun Clach in shinty matches.

name: Seanachaidhean
description: Highland reciters who recite genealogies such as that of Bride.

name: Gruagach
description: Scottish native wizards who alone speak pure Pictish and use Geasa and Curses.

name: Aonaranan
description: Independent magi living in solitude outside covenants in Scotland.

name: Quaesitor
description: Investigating magi of House Quaesitor; Whitburh is the only one in Loch Leglean.

name: Weardmenn
description: Saxon term for the grogs of Horsingas, about fifty warriors.

name: Duguth
description: Old Saxon term Horsingas uses for its band of weardmenn instead of turb.

name: Baresarks
description: Coenwulf's unarmored band of six men and one woman who pride themselves on ferocity.

name: Freiceadanan
description: Guards of Crun Clach: ten lightly armed sith and men.

name: Grogs
description: Covenant soldiers; Horsingas has fifty.

name: Broch-builders
description: Ancient people of the Western Isles conquered by the Picts; possibly builders of the stone monuments.

name: Picts
description: Ancient people of Scotland who absorbed the Broch-builders and whose language was magically erased.

name: Scotti
description: People who brought Gaelic from Ireland in the 500s.

name: Normans
description: Anglo-Norman overlords hated by the magi of Horsingas.

name: Nixons
description: Border family surrounding Horsingas who take tribute from raids and protect the covenant.

name: Fitz-Hubert Family
description: Norman family hostile to the magi of Horsingas.

name: Scottish Church
description: Gaelic-speaking church of Scotland distinct from Roman practice.

name: Order of Odin
description: Norse wizards thought to infest the Isle of Man and possible allies of the Scots.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order of magi whose battles over Man and strictures Horsingas ignores.

name: Ordo Miscellanea
description: Earlier concept a seceding tribunal might return to.

name: House of Canmore
description: Scottish royal dynasty referenced in the history chapter.

name: House Diedne
description: House whose magi cast spells making the Picts forget their language; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: House Mercere
description: House of messengers; Thomas Verus writes as a member and warns against the name Redcap.

name: House Tytalus
description: House of Sir Edwin of Hexham and Aelfred of Little Downing.

name: House Quaesitor
description: House of Whitburh; its prima is Bilera.

name: House Flambeau
description: House of Giuseppe Del Mato.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House of Sir Jehan of Surrey.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House of shapeshifting magi Ealwynn and Coenwulf.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-magic House of Caitlin, Alexander and Iain.

name: House Criamon
description: House of Radislav, seekers of the Enigma.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House of Seumas an Cat.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: The Scottish tribunal of Hermetic magi, with many small covenants and heavy rivalry.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Irish tribunal that helped issue the Partitio Monaviae.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: English tribunal that helped issue the Partitio Monaviae; Whitburh attended it in 1179.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal of the quaesitor who found Whitburh.

name: Covenant of Horsingas
description: Saxon covenant founded 1073 in the Cheviot hills that raids Normans and nears renegade status.

name: Crun Clach
description: Merinita covenant founded 954 inside a faerie mound regio won from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin.

name: Clan Mac Gruagach
description: One of the prime covenants of the Loch Leglean Tribunal.

name: Magvillus
description: Italian covenant where Giuseppe Del Mato trained.

name: Godred Crovan
description: King of Man who seized the Sudreys and Dublin.

name: Magnus Barelegs
description: King who added Kintyre to the kingdom in 1098.

name: Somerled
description: Norse-Gael rebel who defeated Godred of Man in 1156 and gained Islay and Mull.

name: Godred of Man
description: King of Man defeated by Somerled in 1156.

name: Arawn
description: Faerie king of Man who controls the land.

name: Manannan Mac Lir
description: Faerie king of Man who controls the sea; his good will is needed to leave the island.

name: St. Columba
description: Irish missionary saint who founded his first church on Iona and died there in 597.

name: Abbot Blathmac
description: Abbot of Iona killed by Danes in 829 for refusing to reveal Columba's bones.

name: St. Oran
description: Monk of Columba's band buried alive at Iona's first church; prayers to Columba must go through him.

name: Aidan
description: Early king of the Scots buried at Relig Oran.

name: MacBeth
description: King of Scots buried at Relig Oran.

name: Gruoch
description: Queen buried at Relig Oran with MacBeth.

name: St. Patrick
description: Saint for whom at least three wells on Man are named.

name: St. Bride
description: Saint whose feast on February 1 falls on Imbolc.

name: St. Michael
description: Patron saint of the sea and boats, popular in the Islands; feast September 29.

name: Lugh
description: Pagan god once honored at Lughnasa.

name: Kenneth MacAlpin
description: King whose conquest of Pictland spread Gaelic throughout Scotland.

name: David I
description: Scottish king who introduced the silver Scots penny.

name: Thomas Verus of Mercere
description: Mercere author of a guide for travelers in Scotland who counts the independent magi.

name: Sir Edwin of Hexham
description: Tytalus war leader of Horsingas, a knight driven from England who feuds with Guilleme de Fontnevoy.

name: Whitburh Frithowebba
description: The only quaesitor in Loch Leglean, co-leader of Horsingas who hides its crimes and collects blackmail.

name: Giuseppe Del Mato
description: Italian Flambeau magus of Horsingas who hates Normans, attended by mastiff familiar Dent Coccinus.

name: Sir Jehan of Surrey
description: Jerbiton magus of Horsingas with scrambled memory who believes himself Sir Oswald's son and a knight.

name: Ealwynn of Keswick
description: Bjornaer maga of Horsingas with a stoat/ermine heartbeast whose arts shift with the seasons.

name: Coenwulf Eofurcumbol
description: Bjornaer magus of Horsingas with a boar heartbeast and tusks, common-law husband of Ealwynn.

name: Aelfred of Little Downing
description: Former Tytalus chief of Horsingas, withered by a failed longevity potion.

name: Heard Healu
description: Sir Edwin's enchanted, combat-trained magical horse companion under a permanent Steed of Vengeance.

name: Raedbora
description: Whitburh's raven familiar that loves shiny objects.

name: Dent Coccinus
description: Giuseppe Del Mato's mastiff familiar, armored on raids.

name: Hosvir Goatlegs
description: Itinerant Bjornaer mage who raised Ealwynn and Coenwulf; killed and eaten by Norman soldiers.

name: Sir Guilleme de Fontnevoy
description: Harsh Norman Lord of Hexham who raised Edwin and now feuds with him.

name: Lord Fitz-Hubert
description: Norman neighbor of Horsingas.

name: Henry Fitz-Hubert
description: Baron Egremont who tried to imprison Giuseppe Del Mato.

name: Guy, Baron Naworth
description: Uncle of Henry Fitz-Hubert who has borne many Horsingas raids.

name: Abbot Geoffrey
description: Abbot of Hexham Priory, related by marriage to the Fitz-Huberts.

name: Alexander Nixon
description: Chief of the Nixons, friend of Horsingas who takes tribute from raids.

name: Edgar Atheling
description: Saxon heir-apparent whom Horsingas originally sought to restore.

name: William the Conqueror
description: Norman king whose harrying drove the Horsingas founders north.

name: Malcolm Canmore
description: Scottish king whose 1070 foray south the Horsingas founders supported.

name: William the Lion
description: Scottish king in whose army Giuseppe served.

name: William Rufus
description: English king who granted lands to Jehan's family.

name: Sir Oswald of Alfreton
description: Saxon rebel nobleman Jehan squired for and believes to be his father.

name: Drusela of Blackthorn
description: Maga who trained and then cast out Jehan.

name: Cynewulf Gryreleoth
description: Horsingas magus who completed Jehan's training.

name: Bilera
description: Prima of House Quaesitor.

name: Caitlin Suil Uaine
description: Half-faerie Merinita maga of 327 years who rules Crun Clach and is perhaps the most powerful wizard in the Order.

name: Aine
description: Caitlin's young daughter by Oenghus, trained by Alexander.

name: Oenghus
description: Father of Aine, popular and skilled shinty player of the court.

name: Gliocas
description: Caitlin's cu sith faerie dog companion of two hundred years.

name: Alexander the Lame
description: Merinita magus of Crun Clach obsessed with retarding aging; tutor of Aine.

name: Iain Mac Gabhan
description: Merinita second in command of Crun Clach, cursed to turn into a pig when using faerie magic.

name: Triath nan Leathad
description: Iain Mac Gabhan's billy goat familiar.

name: Radislav am Polanach
description: Polish Criamon magus at Crun Clach studying the Enigma among the faeries.

name: Volya
description: Radislav's prankster ferret familiar, friend of Am Balla.

name: Seumas an Cat
description: Ex Miscellanea magus of Crun Clach whose master was executed for diabolism.

name: Sron Dubh
description: Seumas's wildcat familiar, the only Scottish wildcat ever domesticated.

name: Prince of the Grey Jerkin
description: Seelie faerie prince who founded Crun Clach and lost it to Caitlin in shinty.

name: Am Balla
description: The intelligent living stone forming the top level of Crun Clach's regio.

name: Count Gwyridden
description: Arrogant daoine sith shinty champion of Crun Clach who wears red.

name: Steed of Vengeance
description: MuAn 20 spell cast permanently on Heard Healu.

name: Rally the Defeated Troops
description: ReMe 20 spell of Edwin's that rallies troops, granting Brave and Obedient traits.

name: Sharp Shriek of Pain
description: PeCo 20 spell of Edwin's that stabs the ears and deafens.

name: Sure Strike of the Sword
description: ReCo 20 spell of Edwin's granting +2 weapon skill.

name: Trap the Treacherous Tongue
description: ReCo 15 spell of Edwin's holding the target's mouth shut.

name: Endurance of the Berserkers
description: ReCo 15 spell known by Edwin.

name: Panic of the Elephant's Mouse
description: ReAn 15 spell known by Edwin; Caitlin's wand is a focus for it.

name: Rusted Decay of Ten-score Years
description: PeTe 15 spell known by Edwin.

name: Unseen Porter
description: ReTe 15 spell known by Edwin and Whitburh.

name: The Wound that Weeps
description: PeCo 15 spell known by Edwin.

name: Bind the Wound
description: CrCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

name: Eyes of the Cat
description: MuCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

name: Grip of the Choking Hand
description: PeCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

name: Sight of the True Form
description: InCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

name: Curse of Rotting Wood
description: PeHe 5 spell known by Edwin.

name: Destroy Fur and Hide
description: PeAn 5 spell known by Edwin.

name: Invocation of Weariness
description: PeCo 5 spell known by Edwin.

name: Edge of the Razor
description: MuTe 5 effect enchanted on Edwin's broad sword.

name: Awaken the Leafy Warders
description: InHe 35 spell of Whitburh's making plants notify the caster of specified events.

name: Dry Rot of a Hundred Years
description: PeHe 15 spell of Whitburh's destroying ten paces of wooden structure.

name: Figures Through Fire and Fumes
aliases: Enchantment of the Figures Through Fire and Fumes
description: InIg 15 spell of Whitburh's invention.

name: Impair the Hound's Nose
description: PeAn 20 spell known by Whitburh that destroys an animal's sense of smell.

name: The Unhearing Ear
description: PeCo 20 spell of Whitburh's filling the target's ears with wax to deafen.

name: Scrying Pond
description: InAq 35 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Summoning the Distant Images
description: InIm 35 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Voice of the Lake
description: InAq 25 spell known by Whitburh.

name: The Ear for the Distant Voice
description: InIm 20 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Image from the Wizard Torn
description: ReIm 20 spell known by Whitburh.

name: The Call to Slumber
description: ReMe 15 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Invisibility of the Standing Wizard
description: PeIm 15 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Whispering Winds
description: InAu 15 spell known by Whitburh.

name: Strengthen the Shielding Sark
description: MuHe 20 effect enchanted on Whitburh's robes.

name: Disguise of the New Visage
description: Spell Alexander the Lame casts to retard aging.

name: Aura of the Ennobled Presence
description: Spell Alexander the Lame casts to retard aging.

name: Curse of Circe
description: MuCo 30 spell for which Caitlin's oak wand is a focus.

name: Mind of the Beast
description: MuMe 30 effect on Iain's curse table.

name: Cloak of Concealment
description: Caitlin's cloak (MuIm 25) making the wearer hard to pick out.

name: Oak Wand Talisman
description: Caitlin's talisman granting protection from storms and control at a distance.

name: Ring of Plant Mastery
